name: The Buckingham household at 2036 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_buckingham_e

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 2036 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 2036 E. Buckingham & drs.; Clarence Buckingham.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 2036, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 40, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The five live-in staff it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. Left off: Kate S. Buckingham (named in the note on "The Misses Buckingham"); Lucy M. Buckingham (named in the note on "The Misses Buckingham"). The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: E. Buckingham
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Ebenezer Buckingham here as head, born January 1829, in Ohio, widowed, president, bank (ED 40, sheet 9A, line 1, leaf n810).

persons.name: The Misses Buckingham
persons.note: The Blue Book prints '& drs.' after the household's name: two or more unmarried daughters at home, neither named nor counted. One line stands for them all. 'Miss Buckingham' is the book's own form of address, not a recorded name. The 1900 census lists the unmarried daughters at home as Kate S. Buckingham (born August 1859, in Ohio, single; ED 40, sheet 9A, line 3, leaf n810); Lucy M. Buckingham (born September 1862, in Illinois, single; ED 40, sheet 9A, line 4, leaf n810). Which of them the 1904 line stands for, the book does not say.

persons.name: Clarence Buckingham
persons.note: A son is read from the shared surname under the head's listing; the Blue Book does not state the relationship. The 1900 census lists Clarence Buckingham here as son, born November 1854 (the figures are hard to read), in Ohio, single, broker (ED 40, sheet 9A, line 2, leaf n810).

persons.name: Lizzie Valentine

born.note: The census gives January 1871, age 29 on 1 June 1900.

occupation.note: Written as "Parlor maid" in the occupation column on 1 June 1900.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the house, as a servant (parlor maid); born January 1871, in England, came to the United States in 1894, single. Servants changed places often, so this records who worked here in 1900; no source read says whether this person was still here on 1 July 1904. Part of the name is hard to read on the sheet; this is the best reading.
